system.description:
As a Grimward, you must select a Divine Aspect representing the religious authority, sacred principle or theological tradition from which your mandate originates. Your Divine Aspect grants you the following benefits, as appropriate to the aspect selected:
• Edicts: a selection of edicts that must be followed.
• Anathema: actions or behaviours that violate your sacred responsibilities.
• Suggested Ethics: select one appropriate ethic for your character.
• Deific Skill: you gain the associated skill as a class skill.
• Specialist Spell: at 1st level, you gain one appropriate PP 1 Specialist Spell granted by your Divine Aspect.
• Bonus Spells: the bonus spells granted by your Divine Aspect are added to your Grimward repertoire and are always available once you meet their normal casting requirements.
• Favoured Weapon: you gain proficiency with your Divine Aspect's favoured weapon if you do not already possess it, and a +1-class bonus to attacks made with that weapon.

Pick your Divine Aspect from the sheet's Divine Aspect slot: it grants its deific skill, its bonus spells (added to your repertoire as you meet their level), one PP 1 specialist spell of its list, and its favoured weapon — proficiency and the +1 class attack bonus.
